comments.value: Exactly, it's very frustrating as a disabled person, this was my only way to play in VR. I have very limited functionality in my arms and hands. Using a gamepad or DS4 was the only way I could enjoy VR with my headset. I imagine it is a larger accessibility issue if you cannot use alternative methods while in VR other than the motion controllers which a lot of people cannot use. there is a lot of games that are off limits for disabled people because accessibility just isn't considered , but what is sad about this one is that accessibility options were removed.

details:
For years I comfortably used my wired xbox controller while using my HMD (valve index), looking at menu buttons and clicking them with the gamepad trigger or A. When the VR controllers are powered off, there was a cursor coming from the head, like a little dot in the center of the view which used to allow people to still click and control the game without VR controllers while still using a VR headset, clicking with the mouse or pressing a button on another input method to click whatever the center view dot is on.

After this new update, there's no possible way to use my menus with a keyboard or gamepad. The "head cursor" no longer exists, making the game entirely unusable outside of homeworld. Every other button works, and I can open the menu, I just can't select anything without a cursor.

If turning on the VR controllers, the cursors still exist on the hand-tracked controllers, but every other form of input which would allow me to select things using the cursor coming from the center of the head is now completely gone. This game-breaking change is enough for me to stop playing almost entirely, as now I'm limited to an uncomfortable playing experience on VR controllers which only last about 6 hours. Simply returning the head cursor to the way it was before would allow everyone using VR without hand-tracked controllers to continue playing VRChat.
title: UNPLAYABLE! <2024.3.1 Release> Can't Use Menus on Keyboard / Controller While in VR
